info.name: FoundationKit Workbench API
info.description: Requests generated from the same FoundationKit.Workbench.Contracts models used by the Blazor WebAssembly client. The create payload matches BuildBriefRequest.

request.description: Returns whether the client is connected to the local API and SQL Server runtime.
Checks API and SQL Server connectivity.
Returns the canonical FoundationKit packages, capabilities, and project ideas.
